correctness.rationale: The direct open-neighborhood collision lemma for simple cycles of length at least 5 proves equivalence to avoiding 000, 111, 00100; C3 and C4 are separately exact. Maximal alternating runs and the 2-by-2 weighted matrix count cyclic binary words with labelled vertex positions by trace of powers and the n/k marked-run correction. The determinant is exactly 1-z²-z³-z⁴-z⁵-z⁶; subtracting two spurious length-2 words and two invalid length-4 alternating words yields the claimed OGF. The factorization (1+z)(1-z-z³-z⁵) and triangle inequality prove the unique smallest-modulus positive root, hence the exact leading exponential asymptotic. Standalone tests enumerate 131064 memberships n=3..16, agreeing with the graph condition, and independently check coefficients of matrix and determinant series to degree 30.

value.rationale: The result answers a natural quantitative question left by the newly studied mixed domination/locating-domination vertex-partition problem on an elementary but nontrivial infinite graph family. The collision obstruction is a genuine length-five condition beyond the two elementary domination exclusions, and the exact count/generating function/asymptotic identify the rate of rare feasible partitions among all binary labellings; this is substantially more information than existence, a witness or an extremal size.
